title: CAN Termination Meter
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: CAN Bus for Robotics
description: Switch 120 ohm terminators on and off on a CAN bus and watch a resistance meter between CAN_H and CAN_L respond. Then diagnose six meter readings as healthy, one terminator missing, none or a broken wire, an extra terminator, or a short circuit. Used in Chapter 4.

learningObjectives: Infer the state of a CAN bus's termination from the resistance a meter reads between CAN_H and CAN_L, in six readings, with at least 5 of 6 correct on the first attempt

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Change the bus and watch the meter, then reason backward from a reading to the state of the bus
keyQuestions: Why does a healthy bus read 60 ohms and not 120 ohms?
Can the meter tell you where a terminator is, or only how many there are?
commonMisconceptions: Every motor on the bus needs its own terminator
assessmentOpportunities: Six committed diagnoses, one attempt each; 5 of 6 for mastery

controls.label: End A terminator / Middle terminator / End B terminator
Healthy: two terminators / One terminator missing / No terminators or a broken wire / Extra terminator / Short circuit
